title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 200 Israel Road Southeast in Tumwater, Washington, as the Eva G. Hewitt Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 200 Israel Road Southeast in Tumwater, Washington, as the "Eva G. Hewitt Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2019 law renames a Postal Service facility in Tumwater, Washington, as the Eva G. Hewitt Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a official name to a Post Office building at 200 Israel Road Southeast in Tumwater, Washington. The new name honors Eva G. Hewitt. It does not change how mail is handled, what services the office offers, or any rules for customers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 12, 2019.
